0600: Sit on the leverage machine with your back against the backrest and your feet on the footrests.
Grasp the handles or sidebars for stability.
Engage your abs and slowly raise your legs up towards your chest, curling your torso forward at the same time.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your legs and torso back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
0601: Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the machine with your chest against the pad and your feet flat on the floor.
Grasp the handles with a parallel grip, palms facing each other, and keep your arms slightly bent.
Exhale and squeeze your shoulder blades together as you pull the handles back and outward, away from your body.
Pause for a moment at the peak contraction, then inhale and slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
0602: Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the machine with your chest against the pad and your feet flat on the floor.
Grasp the handles with an overhand grip and keep your arms slightly bent.
Exhale and squeeze your shoulder blades together as you pull the handles back and outward, away from your body.
Pause for a moment at the peak contraction, then inhale and slowly return to the starting position.

0603: Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the machine with your back against the backrest.
Grasp the handles with an overhand grip and position your hands at shoulder level.

Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the handles back down to the starting position.

0604: Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the leverage machine with your back against the pad.

Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
0606: Adjust the seat height and footplate position to ensure proper alignment.

Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
0607: Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the machine with your back against the pad.

0608: Sit in the machine and adjust the pads so your torso is secure.
Grip the handles and keep your hips facing forward.
Rotate your torso to one side in a controlled way.
Pause briefly at the end of the range.
Return to the centre and rotate to the other side.

0609: Attach the rope to a high anchor point.
Stand facing away from the anchor point with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the rope with an overhand grip, palms facing down.
Lean forward slightly, keeping your back straight and core engaged.
Pull the rope towards your body, squeezing your shoulder blades together.

Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
0610: Start in a half squat with hands in front of your chest.
Jump your feet out wide, staying low.
Jump them back together and keep your knees bent.
Keep your chest up and weight on your heels.
Keep a steady pace for 30-60 seconds.
0611: Step back into a lunge and lower your back knee toward the floor.
Place your hands on the floor and step into a plank.
Lower into a push-up and press back up.
Step back into the lunge and stand up.
Alternate the lunging leg each rep.
0612: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Take a big step forward with one leg.
Lower your hips until both knees are bent about 90 degrees.
Keep your torso upright and front knee over your ankle.
Push through the front heel to return to standing.
0613: Lie on your side with your legs straight.

0614: Lie face down with arms by your sides or under your forehead.

Lift one leg off the floor while squeezing your glute.

0615: Lie on your back with arms out to the sides.
Bend one knee and bring it across your body.

Keep both shoulders flat on the floor.
0616: Lie on your back near the edge of a bench or bed.
Pull one knee toward your chest and hold it.
Let the other leg hang down relaxed over the edge.

0619: Lie on your back with both legs straight.

0647: Stand with your back close to a wall, feet shoulder width apart.

Drop straight back into the sit and repeat.
